title: Nothing shows the sandbox is on, /doctor says 'settings user, user, project', and unsupported hook events go unreported
observed: kiln defect (UX). With ~/.kiln/settings.json sandbox.enabled=true, sandboxed commands ran and blocked writes outside the workspace ('Operation not permitted'), but the banner, status line, bash block meta ('auto-approved') and /doctor never mention the sandbox. /doctor prints 'settings   user, user, project' (~/.claude/settings.json and ~/.kiln/settings.json both labelled 'user') and 'hooks 8 hooks on 7 events'. The user settings define 13 hook events; PermissionRequest, PostCompact, PostToolUseFailure, StopFailure, SubagentStart and TeammateIdle are dropped without a note.
expected: /doctor (and ideally the bash block meta) shows sandbox state; settings rows name the file (~/.claude, ~/.kiln); hook events kiln does not fire are listed as unsupported.
